				fx.Annotate(
					blobstorage.NewBlobStorage,
					fx.As(new(command.X)),
				),
			),
			fx.Options(opts...),
			fx.Invoke(func(router httpsrvr.Router) {
				router.AddRoutes()
			}),
			fx.Invoke(
				initializeDBCloseHook,
				initializeWatermillRunHook,
				initializeWatermillCloseHook,
